headline:
Screen recordings.
Worth watching.
description: Capture your screen. Make the result your own.
direction: Actual Store editor with the Routine demo project open, a readable preview and the timeline visible. Capture the completed editor view for the hero; do not show the permissions screen.

headline:
Less waiting.
More showing.
description: Trim the take. Cut the pauses. Set the pace.
direction: Actual Store editor with a real cut and speed region in the disposable demo project. Make both timeline tracks readable. Keep the full app window; no invented timeline regions.

headline:
A better frame
for every idea.
description: Choose a background, spacing and rounded corners.
direction: Actual Store editor with Video properties selected and the real background, padding and corner controls visible. Use the same demo project with an intentional restrained background.

headline:
Bring the details
into focus.
description: Guide the viewer with editable zoom regions.
direction: Actual Store editor paused inside an active zoom region. Show the Zoom properties and corresponding timeline region. The zoom must be an AppShow edit, not a crop applied to the screenshot.

headline:
From your screen
to their screen.
description: Choose your format, resolution and frame rate.
direction: Actual Store export sheet over the demo project. Show real format, resolution and frame-rate choices. Validate each advertised export in the candidate before submission.
